inputs.payload: I want to create three small files one at a time, and I will review each one before you do the next. First, create a todo list with exactly three items: (1) create alpha.txt containing the single line A, (2) create beta.txt containing the single line B, (3) create gamma.txt containing the single line C. Then do ONLY item 1. After alpha.txt exists, stop and wait for my explicit go-ahead. Do NOT create beta.txt or gamma.txt in this turn.
Do not create, modify or delete any file in this turn. Just run `ls -1` in the current directory and tell me exactly which files exist right now.
